facts.claim: Foreign couples spent an average of €67,000 per wedding in Italy in 2025, a rise of almost 9% on the previous year.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (citing Centro Studi Turistici, Florence)
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed live 2026-11-23, unchanged (key takeaway). Page published 2026-10-14, modified 2026-11-05. Same page: 'Foreign couples held around 16,700 weddings in Italy in 2025'. EUR, no conversion.

facts.claim: The real wedding in Italy cost runs from about €20,000 to over €120,000, depending on region, season and guest count.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged. Same page: 'Smaller, simpler celebrations come in lower, with some planners placing the overall cost at €20,000 to €35,000.' EUR.

facts.claim: One Tuscan planner reports that a high-quality wedding generally lands between €800 and €1,200 per guest. On that basis, 50 guests sits around €40,000 to €60,000, and 100 guests around €80,000 to €120,000.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed: first sentence and the 100-guest figure seen live today; 50-guest wording not re-seen in the extract, writer to confirm. Planner unnamed. EUR.

facts.claim: Many Lake Como weddings for 60 guests land between €80,000 and €150,000 before flights and guest rooms.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged (full text read). Three-day celebration; excludes flights, attire and guest accommodation; 'These are planning estimates, not quotes.' Downgraded to low: SITE-CONFLICT-03 with F-33. EUR.

facts.claim: Lake Como typical totals: Intimate, 20-30 guests, €30,000–€65,000; Classic, 60 guests, €80,000–€150,000; Grand, 100+ guests, €150,000–€300,000+.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged. SITE-CONFLICT-03. Writer replaces range dashes with 'to'. EUR.

facts.claim: A welcome aperitivo and a farewell lunch can add 25–40% on top of the wedding-day total. Italian VAT is 22% on most services, so check whether each quote includes it.
facts.use_note: Not re-seen verbatim today (beyond scrape truncation); takeaway 'Welcome dinners, venue extras and VAT are the costs couples most often miss' is live. VAT from own page only.

facts.claim: For a beautifully executed 100-guest wedding in Bali, Nicky recommends budgeting USD $38,000-$84,000, with luxury celebrations comfortably exceeding $112,000+ depending on venue, production, styling and guest experience.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Nicky Almeida, Nix Wedding Planner)
facts.use_note: Not re-scraped today (page still listed live in site map). SITE-CONFLICT-01, now three-way with F-09 and F-41. USD.

facts.claim: Budgets range from around AUD $5,000 for an intimate celebration to $50,000 or more for a luxury villa or resort event.
facts.use_note: Not re-scraped today. SITE-CONFLICT-01. Do not repeat the hub's unsourced 'costs less than at home' claim.

facts.claim: A Fiji wedding typically costs FJD $10,000 to $30,000 (about USD $4,500 to $13,500, or AUD $6,800 to $20,500 as stated in the source).
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged. Published 2026-11-17. Lead with FJD; the USD and AUD equivalents are the page's own.

facts.claim: A Maldives resort wedding for 20 guests typically costs between US$25,000 and US$60,000 all-in.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged. Published 2026-11-16, modified 2026-11-17. 'The ceremony package, villa stays and transfers carry most of the total.' USD.

facts.claim: A Santorini wedding typically costs from €4,000 for an elopement to €55,000 or more, depending on guest count and style.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed unchanged (full text read). Note the H1 now reads 'Santorini Wedding Cost Breakdown From a Real Couple' while the title tag says 'for 2027, Line by Line'; no real couple is named on the page. EUR.

facts.claim: An Amalfi Coast wedding for 60 to 80 guests typically costs €60,000 to €110,000 or more, and luxury multi-day celebrations at landmark villas run €150,000 to €450,000 or more.
facts.use_note: Reconfirmed; figures unchanged, live wording uses 'and' where the 19 Nov record had 'while'. Claim updated to today's wording. EUR.

facts.claim: Planners quote it in two main ways, a flat fee for a written scope or a percentage of your wedding budget, usually with a minimum fee underneath. Percentage fees commonly run at 10 to 15%, and some luxury planners charge 18 to 20%.
facts.use_note: Not re-scraped; site-map description today matches ('Percentage fees ...').

facts.claim: Medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas. Most countries won't give you free or subsidised care. You, or your insurer, must usually pay full price.
The average price for a comprehensive policy varies from $100 for travel in the Pacific to over $1700 for travel in Africa.
facts.use_note: Authored by CHOICE, hosted on smartraveller.gov.au. Table: Europe $267 to $1335, Asia $112 to $1024, Pacific $78 to $307, Americas $495 to $1630. Quote the text or the table, not both.

facts.claim: Smartraveller says the right travel insurance is as essential as a passport for overseas travel, for every traveller.
Always read the Product Disclosure Statement (PDS) before buying; it sets out inclusions, exclusions, definitions, the claims process and emergency support.
Lake Como, the Amalfi Coast and Chianti are the most requested regions, while Puglia offers the better value.
facts.use_note: Key takeaway on our Italy guide. Only own-page 'value' judgement found for Italy; no Puglia total figure was captured. Useful for the ranking logic, attribute to our guide.

facts.claim: Food and drink is the biggest line item at roughly a third of the budget, and destination-standard catering usually costs €150 to €220 per guest.
facts.use_note: Same page tiers: 'Expect €110 to €150 per guest at the lower mid-range, €150 to €220 for a strong destination-wedding standard, €220 to €300 for premium service, and more than €300 for a five-star experience.' Extractor wording; confirm before quoting. EUR.

facts.claim: Choosing a shoulder-season month can take up to a fifth off your venue fee. Most Italian weddings happen between April and October, so shoulder months like April and October give you the most leverage. Some villas charge noticeably less in March, April and October than in July and August.
facts.use_note: Season lever for value ranking. Extractor wording.

facts.claim: June and September dates are often gone 18 months ahead.
facts.use_note: Italy lead time.

facts.claim: Tuscany: exclusive hire for 60 to 80 guests across three nights typically starts at around €27,000 to €30,000 in 2026. One Lake Garda villa offers a 2026 two-night exclusive package from €24,000 to €30,000, depending on the month. A ceremony at Villa del Balbianello for up to 50 guests, held while the villa is closed to the public, is quoted at about €6,900.
facts.use_note: Venue-level figures relayed on our page; the venues' own sites were not checked in this FAST pass. Venue hire only, not totals. EUR.

facts.claim: A midweek or shoulder-season date, or a smaller guest list, can cut the total by 20–30%. Catering and drinks (€250–€450 per guest). Boats and transfers (€3,000–€12,000). Florals and styling (€8,000–€30,000). Venue (€10,000–€60,000+).
facts.use_note: Full text read. Line items assume a 60-guest wedding and exclude welcome and farewell events and VAT. Page adds that many villas sit on steep shores so suppliers may arrive by barge, a logistics premium built into most quotes. EUR.

facts.claim: A Lake Como wedding for 60 guests typically costs between €45,000 and €90,000 for a standard-to-elevated celebration, and grand villas can exceed €150,000.
facts.use_note: SITE-CONFLICT-03 with F-05/F-06 (€80,000 to €150,000 for 60 guests, three days). Published 2026-11-17, titled 'for 60 Guests in 2027'. Page also gives 'US$65,000toUS$95,000' (its own equivalent), venue €5,000 to €25,000+, catering €18,000 to €30,000 (€150 to €300+ a head), planner €3,000 to €15,000+, VAT 10% to 22%. Scope differs (single day vs three-day) but neither page says so explicitly. EUR.

facts.claim: Venue and ceremony costs run from €10,000 to €50,000 or more by venue type, and many service invoices carry 22% VAT. Florals, design and rentals run €25,000 to €80,000, and entertainment and sound €15,000 to €30,000. Catering and bar (€180 to €310+ a head). Full-service planner 10% to 15% of the total. Contingency about 10% of the total.
facts.use_note: Full text read. Page disclaimer: 'All prices are indicative and based on published rates at the time of writing.' Page says elaborate banquets 'may exceed €450 per person'. EUR.

facts.claim: Accommodation in neighbouring destinations such as Atrani, Minori and Sorrento may provide additional options for guests, although savings compared with Positano or Ravello depend on the property, season and availability.
facts.use_note: Value lever for guests. Hedged on the page; keep the hedge.

facts.claim: Elopement: 2 to 20 guests, €4,000 to €12,000. Micro wedding: 20 to 40 guests, €18,000 to €30,000. Standard wedding: 50 to 80 guests, €30,000 to €55,000. Luxury wedding: 80+ guests, €55,000+.
facts.use_note: Table on our Santorini guide, full text read. Gives a like-for-like 50 to 80 guest band to compare with Amalfi (F-14). EUR.

facts.claim: Venue rental runs €400 to €1,500 or more, while catering is priced at €75 to €160 or more a head. A wedding planner typically costs €3,000 to €5,000 or more, and helps with local Greek paperwork, translators and day-of coordination.
facts.use_note: Page also says florals €1,500 to €12,000+, photography €600 to €3,000+, and that accommodation is a separate part of the budget. Le Ciel capacity 'up to 80 seated guests' is relayed from the venue; check the venue site if used. EUR.

facts.claim: Resort ceremony packages range from about US$1,500 to US$5,000 before tax. Transfers run US$400 to US$820 a person by seaplane and US$100 to US$490 by speedboat. Villa stay, per night US$800 to US$3,000+. Reception, per person from US$250+. Tax and service charge 27% (10% service charge plus 17% GST). Green tax, per person per night US$12.
facts.use_note: Table rows on our Maldives guide. Tax rates are from our page only; an official Maldives Inland Revenue Authority source would make them high confidence. USD.

facts.claim: May to October is the low season, which can lower resort rates. A package often covers the ceremony location, a basic floral arrangement and an officiant.
facts.use_note: Extractor wording. Page also: 'Most resorts are on private islands reached by seaplane or speedboat, and each guest travels on a separate fare.' Season claim is ours, not an official climate source.

facts.claim: A classic resort wedding runs FJD $10,000 to $20,000, and luxury weddings FJD $25,000 to $75,000 or more. Each guest beyond the package adds about FJD $130 to $180 or more. Legal fees $90 to $145.
facts.use_note: Page also: 'A package often covers the ceremony site, a basic reception setup and a coordinator.' Legal fee from our page only; Fiji government source not checked. FJD.

facts.claim: A Bali wedding for 80 guests typically costs US$20,000 to US$60,000 (approximately IDR 350 million to over 950 million) for a standard-to-mid-range celebration. Luxury resort and clifftop weddings sit in a higher tier, from US$45,000 to US$90,000 or more. Many Bali hotels and vendors add a 21% tax and service charge on top of quoted prices.
facts.use_note: NEW since 19 Nov pack (published 2026-11-17). Third Bali figure on our site: SITE-CONFLICT-01 is now three-way (F-08 USD 38,000 to 84,000 for 100 guests; F-09 AUD 5,000 to 50,000+; F-41 USD 20,000 to 60,000 for 80 guests, luxury USD 45,000 to 90,000+). Mid-range tier described as 'venue, basic-to-moderate styling and florals, a three-to-five-course dinner, open bar, photographer and videographer, coordinator and DJ' for US$20,000 to US$40,000. Banjar fees IDR 3.5 million to 7.5 million+. USD/IDR.

facts.claim: Most small weddings in Italy for 15 to 40 guests land between €18,000 and €35,000, and micro weddings of 10 to 20 guests typically run €15,000 to €28,000. Budget €800 to €1,600 per guest for a micro wedding and €500 to €1,200 at 20 to 40.
facts.use_note: Published 2026-10-26. Page says planner partners Federica Beni Events and SPOSIAMOVI 'expect prices to hold fairly steady into 2027'. Lead time: '12 to 18 months is comfortable for a peak-season Saturday ... 6 to 9 months is workable for a weekday or a shoulder-season date.' EUR, excludes VAT.

facts.claim: Guest flights, guest accommodation, 22 percent VAT and supplier travel usually sit outside quoted budgets. Hold back 8 to 10 percent for the unexpected. VAT is 22 percent on most services and 10 percent on hotel stays and restaurant meals.
facts.use_note: VAT rates from our page only; Agenzia delle Entrate not checked (gap G-06 carried).

facts.claim: Packages in a 2026 round-up of Dubai venues range from AED 200 to AED 595 per person. Some luxury spaces set a minimum spend, from AED 60,000 at a desert resort to AED 120,000 for an outdoor amphitheatre. Ask whether a quoted rate includes the 7% municipality fee, 10% service charge and 5% VAT.
facts.use_note: Published 2026-11-11. Per-person package prices, not totals; examples AED 200 (Al Jaddaf Rotana) to AED 595 (Al Maha). 'Packages valid until 30 December 2026.' The '2026 round-up' source is not named in the extract; check before quoting. AED.

facts.claim: A 2022 index put the couple's costs for a Dubai wedding at US$25,463.
facts.use_note: Index not named in the extract and four years old. Do not use unless the underlying source is confirmed as non-competitor. USD.

facts.claim: On long-term averages at Heraklion and near Chania, May and September bring highs of about 24 to 27 degrees with few rain days, while most rain falls between October and April.
facts.use_note: Published 2026-11-12. Climate claim on our page; needs an official met-office source (HNMS) before stating. The Crete page gives NO total cost figure, only cost drivers (season, room blocks, minimum stays, exclusive use).

facts.claim: Our how-much-is-a-destination-wedding page sets out costs by region and guest count across Europe, Asia, Oceania, the Middle East and North America and Mexico, with resort package prices (from USD 4,000++ at Anantara Uluwatu Bali to FJD 6,999 at Fiji Marriott Momi Bay; THB 580,000 net for the Pearl Package at Conrad Koh Samui; US$5,049 for 20 guests at Dreams Los Cabos).
facts.use_note: Coverage note, published 2026-11-18. Cannibalisation risk: region and guest-count framing overlaps. It does not rank by value. Its Greece figure ('€157,000 to €160,000 before VAT') comes from an industry survey reported by Greek City Times: DO NOT USE as a cited figure. Resort package prices relayed from venues, venue sites not checked; only Thailand and Mexico figures on the site sit here.

facts.claim: Our average-destination-wedding-cost-by-region page gives dated figures for Italy (€67,000 average) and Lake Como (€80,000 to €150,000 for 2026 to 2027), discusses Bali, Greece, Fiji, Ras Al Khaimah, Qatar and Mexico, and covers how a destination wedding compares with Australia, costs no average includes, currency and deposits, mark-ups, room blocks, transfers, legal paperwork, planners and all-inclusive packages.
facts.use_note: Coverage note so we do not repeat it. Published 2026-11-20. Two extractor passes disagreed on whether it ranks by value; the H2 list shows no ranking section, so treat as not ranked. Do not repeat its hidden-cost, currency, room-block or legal sections; link to it instead.
